outline: Ground improvement plays a crucial role in enhancing the stability and performance of problematic soils in construction engineering. This course explores key concepts, including ground improvement measures such as compaction, dewatering, preloading, vibroflotation, soil grouting, and soil-lime stabilization, all of which are essential for strengthening weak soils and ensuring the safety and longevity of construction projects.
